brief: The 6 best design tools for indie founders in 2026 — what each one wins at.

slots.body: Figma remains the universal home for product teams who need real-time collaboration and component libraries that scale across platforms.
slots.tileValue: Start with variables and modes to ship faster.

slots.body: Webflow gives founders enterprise-grade CMS control without hiring a frontend engineer, perfect for marketing and content hubs.
slots.tileValue: Structure content once, then scale pages effortlessly.

slots.body: Framer blurs the line between prototype and production, letting indie makers publish performant sites straight from the canvas.
slots.tileValue: Skip handoff by deploying your frame directly.

slots.body: Canva’s AI suite turns non-designers into visual storytellers, making it ideal for social posts, pitch decks, and ads.
slots.tileValue: One design becomes ten formats instantly.

slots.body: Spline lets founders embed lightweight 3D interactions into websites without touching WebGL, adding instant premium polish.
slots.tileValue: Drop the iframe into Webflow or Framer.

slots.body: Pitch combines presentation design with real-time collaboration, so founders can close investors without wrestling with slides.
slots.tileValue: Link charts to Google Sheets for real-time updates.

slots.tagline: Clear, founder-focused design tips every week. No fluff, just tools that ship.
